name: gameplay-greenzone-flag
origin: Green Zone's flag held (checkpoint 5, modes), on the round of gameplay-greenzone-start (seed 42, Green Zone, Normal, Cinema, robot 0; the AI robots stopped at the round's first frame): the reposition fixture puts the player above the flag (10,6; the fixture takes only an empty floor cell) and it walks down onto the flag's cell (10,7) for 7 frames. Flag.runEngine gives it the first slot and its r0_progress bar at int(totalTime / maxTime * 100) (holding, 30 frames on); at maxTime (flag 3 x 35 = 105) Flag.complete scores the point (HUD 1/10), takes the bar off and plays the nested clip from "got it" (got-it). The flag's move after TweenMax.delayedCall(3) runs on the host clock and is not captured.
godot_note: Godot's player is put on the same cell (Game.reposition_human); the flag and its bars are drawn by scripts/ui/game_board.gd from the mode's state.

wall_clock_text./@0#1/@0/time: Game.countTime counts Date seconds; the reference player's Date follows the host clock, not its stepped frames, so TIME differs between the recording and Godot

actions.godot_note: The round this START opens takes its board and enemy robots from the golden of the greenzone-start capture (App.round_as_recorded), as gameplay-cinema-start does.
